test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A number X is 60% of the average of 20, 28 and 36. What is the value of the number X?
solution:
FORMULA USED:

Average = Sum of all numbers/number of terms

CALCULATION:

Average = (20 + 28 + 36)/3 = 28

According to the question:

X = 28 × 60%

⇒ X = 168/10

⇒ X = 16.8

∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.
